create_monotonic_decoder_model: create a Monotonic Decoder model from a MonotonicDecoderConfig with optional device and dtype
build_monotonic_decoder_embedding: build an embedding table with vocabulary size, embedding dimension, and padding index
build_monotonic_decoder_frontend: build a Transformer decoder front-end with embedding, sinusoidal position encoding, and dropout
build_monotonic_decoder_layer: build a MonotonicTransformerDecoderLayer with self-attention, cross-attention, PChoose layer, and feed-forward network
build_monotonic_decoder_p_choose_layer: build a PChooseLayer for computing p_choose with energy bias, temperature, and pre-decision pooling
